Morning/shift customs, appreciation versus fatigue diagnosis, ongoing おつかれさまです versus completed おつかれさまでした, superior nuance of ご苦労さま without universal prohibition, safety wish versus certification, and greeting versus full understanding preserved.
criticalChecks.114: Entry greeting versus permission, interruptions with reason/consideration, leaving greeting versus handover, 危ない/よけろ urgency and imperative comprehension preserved. No universal movement, posture, direction or rescue instruction added.
criticalChecks.115: Construction setting-out positions/heights, drawing grids, references, centerlines versus member faces, noncoincident wall/column centers, master marks versus darkness/age, revision/marked-surface correspondence and handover purpose preserved.
criticalChecks.116: Offsets versus actual target, distance AND side AND original reference, no universal offset direction; both rokuzumi and rikuzumi and contextual alias meanings retained; horizontal height line versus floor surface, vertical marks not all centers, floor marks not automatic height references, finish relationships without universal thickness/procedure preserved.
criticalChecks.117: Inked-string reel versus laser-light references, knowing names versus competent operation, right-angle setting-out versus long-line drawing, no numerical angle added; timber processing marks versus building setting-out, identifier versus count, orientation/drawing information and multi-name marks preserved. No calibration/cutting/joining/erasure/relocation procedure.
criticalChecks.118: Temporary building/civil setting-out references not completed faces or universal setup; horizontal board versus string, no guaranteed correctness; level establishment versus historically used water-level can and no present-day universal requirement; ground rope layout versus legal land boundaries preserved. No survey/setup procedure.
criticalChecks.119: BM point position and height, movement/loss checks, GL existing/planned ground and FH planned-ground height, FL finished-floor/storey labels 1FL/2FL rather than metres, SL legend-dependent slab surface rather than universal definition/equality, CH finished-floor to finished-ceiling rather than BM elevation preserved. corrections.reason: 役職が分からない相手 means the other person whose position/rank is unknown to the speaker. पद न जानने वाले व्यक्ति can instead describe a person who does not know the rank. Clarify whose rank is unknown while retaining the fictional example and no assumed hierarchy.

corrections.sourceJa: 学習用の連絡例では、午前中の問い合わせは「おつかれさまです」から始め、資料整理が終わった相手には「おつかれさまでした」と伝えます。どちらも、その後に必要な用件を説明できます。
